role: frequency-ordered word list (seed-only language: the app bundles the whole list, nothing to download)
generationVersion: gen-tatoeba-words.py v1 (HKeyboard scripts/; Batch 9 added --uzbek-apostrophes and the okina/glottal joiners)
generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang uz --script latin --min-count 2 --stop "tom,mary,john,jim,mike,ken,sami,layla,jane,bill,bob,jack,maria,mari,tomning,tomni,tomga" --out uz_words.txt uzb_text.txt --uzbek-apostrophes
transformations: gen-tatoeba-words.py: tokens of Latin letters (+ apostrophe joiners); Tatoeba placeholder names dropped (--stop); words seen only once dropped (min-count 2 - a small corpus); ordered by count desc then first occurrence; o'/g' spellings normalised to the CLDR okina U+02BB and other apostrophes to U+02BC
